story: In Stage 3 of the Ethias-Tour de Wallonie 2026, a six-rider breakaway was caught with 10km remaining. A major crash occurred 1.8km from the finish, leaving only about twelve riders to contest. Laurence Pithie won the sprint ahead of Kim Heiduk and Krists Neilands.
